content: # {platform.name} 播放列表导出说明 / Playlist Export Guide
本目录由 WebGamelistOper 导出，供 RetroArch 使用。
Exported by WebGamelistOper for use with RetroArch.
## 重要提示 / Important
- 请务必确保游戏 ROM 文件位于播放列表 .lpl 中记录的 path 路径上，否则 RetroArch 无法加载运行游戏。
- Make sure your ROM files are located at the exact paths recorded in the .lpl playlist, otherwise RetroArch cannot launch the games.
## 目录结构 / Directory Structure
- playlists/{platform.name}.lpl — 播放列表文件 / playlist file
- thumbnails/{platform.name}/ — 缩略图 / thumbnails（Named_Boxarts / Named_Snaps / Named_Titles / Named_Logos）
## 安装到 RetroArch / Install to RetroArch
1. 将 playlists/{platform.name}.lpl 复制到 RetroArch 的 playlists 目录 / Copy playlists/{platform.name}.lpl into the RetroArch playlists directory
2. 将 thumbnails/{platform.name} 文件夹复制到 RetroArch 的 thumbnails 目录 / Copy the thumbnails/{platform.name} folder into the RetroArch thumbnails directory
3. 打开 RetroArch → 播放列表 → 导入内容 → 手动扫描，选择 {platform.name}.lpl / Open RetroArch → Playlists → Import Content → Manual Scan and choose {platform.name}.lpl
## 注意事项 / Notes
- 播放列表中的 path 是导出时游戏文件的绝对路径；若游戏文件移动过，或在其他设备（NAS / Docker 等）上使用，请用文本编辑器批量替换路径前缀

- The path field stores the absolute ROM path captured at export time; if the ROMs have been moved or are used on another device (NAS / Docker, etc.), batch-replace the path prefix with a text editor.
- core_path / core_name 已设为 DETECT，RetroArch 会自动匹配已安装的核心
- core_path / core_name are set to DETECT, so RetroArch automatically matches installed cores.
- 兼容 RetroArch 1.5+ JSON 播放列表格式；不支持旧版 6-Line 行格式（如 Lakka）
- Compatible with RetroArch 1.5+ JSON playlists; the legacy 6-Line format (e.g. Lakka) is not supported.
- 缩略图文件名按 RetroArch 规则生成：显示名中的非法字符 &*/:\<>?| 会替换为 _
- Thumbnail names follow RetroArch rules: illegal characters &*/:\<>?| in display names are replaced with _.
- crc32 已写入播放列表，RetroArch 可优先按 CRC 匹配缩略图
- crc32 is written into the playlist, so RetroArch can match thumbnails by CRC first.
